description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools—TextBlob, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two categories of Twitter data: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” where “Overall Tweet” refers to all tweets including those with emojis. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2. For “Emoji Tweets,” TextBlob (white bar) achieves approximately 0.4 accuracy, VADER (hatched bar) reaches about 0.5, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) attains the highest accuracy at roughly 0.7. In the “Overall Tweet” category, TextBlob drops slightly to around 0.35, VADER remains near 0.5, and ChatGPT again leads with approximately 0.65 accuracy. The legend in the upper right corner identifies each tool by its bar pattern and color: white for TextBlob, hatched for VADER, and solid green for ChatGPT. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s superior performance in both tweet categories, particularly for emoji-containing tweets, while VADER consistently outperforms TextBlob. No error bars or statistical significance indicators are shown.
